name: Tour Penchée
notes: Rarely visited sector, away from the crowds.
Short, bouldery climbing on often overhanging rock, ranging from poor to exceptional quality.
Some routes are sheltered from the rain.
Route numbers restart at 1 on this tower.
routes: Leaning slab on a somewhat austere face.
The tower's normal route; easy but earthy. Not the most interesting at the grade.
Sustained, fingery first part. A really technical leaning slab.
Big lying-down corner allowing a great rising traverse on jugs. Surprising and fun overall.
Disconcerting climbing crossing two corners. A must-do.
Climbing on good holds on steep ground.
Finishing variant of route 5. Nice, surprising route.
Varied, very interesting climbing that demands strength and determination right to the anchor.
Bouldery climbing. Core tension and compression on the programme.
Continuous, complex overhang; rock sometimes crumbly.
Overhang on bands that aren't always easy to use well. One big boulder problem.
Traversing overhang that visits every route exit on the face. Poor rock.
Route on good holds, traversing slightly left.
A nice traverse that deserves a visit. Joins every anchor on the face.
Another traverse with an original path.
Fun route on good holds, a bit physical.
Traversing route following a good diagonal step. Shared finish with 21 and 23.
Climbing on astonishing rock bands. Fun route.
Start from a block on the ground, then a slightly overhanging slab striped with thin cracks.
The first route bolted on the leaning tower. Surprising climbing on a slight rising traverse. A must-do.
Pas de prises, pas de surprises
Fingery slab with an easier finish.
A Football World (pun on 'un monde fou')
Finishing variant of route 25. Really steep.
Disconcerting climbing with a weird corner and a tough little roof. Fun overall.
Tant qu'il y aura des freins à main
As Long as There Are Handbrakes
Nice arête line. Climbing on big holds with feet that aren't always visible.
